goal: Remove reviewed high/critical dependency exposures and repair authorized security boundaries
input: Pinned remote base, lockfile, synthetic fixtures
output: Focused source/dependency patch and this evidence

performance.name: Family
performance.environment: Windows x64, Node 24.22.1, same source/mode, sequential; fixture config, not deployed

monthly_cost: No new services, billing plans or paid API introduced; synthetic verification uses local tools. Production quota/traffic acceptance not performed.
limitations: Public npm advisories are a point-in-time dependency check, not full SAST, history or binary compromise analysis.
Build and fixture performance do not establish production latency.
Default machine Node 24.14.1 remains outside the portable verification runtime.

security_contract.approval: Every protected data API request rechecks current approval; removed users 403; source unavailable 503; owner follows current configuration
security_contract.images: v2 HMAC binds path/version/24h expiry; legacy signatures rejected; private,no-store; persisted avatars reissued
security_contract.remaining_window: Bearer URLs already obtained remain valid until 24h expiry; old caches and downloaded files cannot be recalled
security_contract.fixture_latency_gate: 50 warm synthetic API calls after 5 warmups; p95<100ms asserted by passing security test; not real GitHub latency
security_contract.migration: No data migration; deploy Worker intentionally, then reload frontend data to renew image links; old open pages may need reload
security_contract.cost: One extra GitHub read per protected member data API request; rate/quota and real upstream latency pending release acceptance
